title: 第7章 筑基第8章 长老叛变
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 接下来的几天，日子过得波澜不惊。莫凡还是每天晚上与雪儿相拥而眠。但最亲密的举动，也不过是亲亲雪儿的额头。
并非莫凡是正人君子，而是他从少阁主莫凡的记忆中得知，在玄武大陆有一个说法，破身过早，不管对于男人还是女人，对以后的修炼进度、修炼所能达到的高度都会有所影响。
除非达到元婴境，是否童子身就无关紧要了。
所以，就算莫凡对怀里的美人如何蠢蠢欲动，都不得不按捺住。
晚上，雪儿依靠在莫凡怀里，小脸红红的，低声呢喃，“小凡，我跟你成亲，是真心喜欢你的，你对我的心意呢？”
莫凡用力抱了抱雪儿，说道：“我对你的心意当然也是真的，日月可鉴！”
莫凡一愣，然后才明白雪儿说的是什么。他抚着雪儿的秀发，“我不想因为那事儿影响了你修炼。”
雪儿在莫凡怀里拱了拱，“就算有影响，我不后悔。我怕......”
莫凡知道她担心的是自己时日无多。
“不用担心这个，我现在身体慢慢好起来了，你没发现吗，我现在自己来去自如，小月不在我身边都没事。我会活得很长久，将来跟你一起遨游这玄武大陆。”莫凡语气很坚定。
“真的？你不会抛下我？”
“不会。”
“那我们拉钩。”
拉钩之后，雪儿沉沉睡去。
莫凡悄悄起身，来到院子里打坐修炼。
如此修炼五六天，莫凡的境界已经来到了炼气九层。
从没有一丝灵力的普通人，修炼到炼气九层，只用了数日，这个修炼速度放在整个玄武大陆，可以说是惊世骇俗了。
不过，按少阁主的年龄来算，已经二十岁了，还只是筑基，还是废物一个。
玄武大陆以武为尊，崇尚修炼，除了像少阁主莫凡这样无法修炼的人之外，无不从小就开始修炼，或加入宗门，或加入宗族势力，或进入朝廷开办的修真学院。
据说，玄武大陆最耀眼的天才，是天玄宗的一位少年，以十五岁零三个月迈入结丹境，创下了最年轻的结丹记录。
跟这些天才比起来，莫凡觉得自己目前的境界还狗屁都是不是。
但是，我手里有戒指啊。目前所发现它的神秘，可能还只是很小的一部分而已。或许，戒指就是他踏临玄武大陆巅峰的最大助力。
而且，以现在这个修炼速度，要赶上那些天才，绝对是有可能的。莫凡信心满满！
这一天晚上，莫凡照例在院子里修炼。当天地灵气注入身体转换为灵力后，莫凡的丹田位置传来一阵鼓胀之感。
要突破了！莫凡暗暗兴奋。
持续不断的灵力向丹田汇聚，鼓胀的感觉越来越强烈。
终于，身体里传来“咔嚓”的一声，突破到筑基期了！
莫凡以神识内视丹田，发现丹田里已经形成一个小小的湖泊。湖泊不过一丈见方，里面是灵力凝聚而成的湖水，湖面上氤氲着尚未凝聚成湖水的灵力浓雾。
筑基了，以玄武大陆的标准来说，这才是真正的修真的起点！只有达到筑基期，才真正跟普通人区别开来。
抑制住内心的兴奋，莫凡继续运转长青诀，吸收这天地灵气。
源源不断的灵气进入身体，又转化为灵力，向丹田汇聚。莫凡的丹田也在一点点的扩大，从开始的一丈，慢慢扩展到一丈半，两丈，两丈半，三丈。丹田湖泊稳定了下来，而莫凡的境界，也稳定在了筑基一层。
稳定了境界，莫凡又练了一遍云霄剑法。这套剑法，经过戒指的一番改进后，威力比原来又增加了许多。莫凡估量着，云霄剑法现在的品级，应该有地级上品了吧。当然，以莫凡的境界还不能发挥出剑法的全部威力。
而且，莫凡隐隐中感觉，这云霄剑法应该还能继续晋级。
云霄剑法以及它的运剑法诀，莫凡都已经全部教给了莫唯风、黎秋兰以及雪儿。等青云宗找上门来，云霄剑法或许会给他们一个惊喜。
如此又将过去二十多日。这天，云霄阁议事大殿内，莫唯风坐在大殿正上方的宝座上，两侧各排着十几张椅子，分别坐着五大长老，传功殿、武技殿、丹药殿、执法殿等殿主。黎秋兰、莫凡则分别站在莫唯风身后两侧。
莫唯风缓缓开口；“各位，按着大长老之意，今日召集各位在此商议明日如何应对青云宗之事。各位可有何应对之策？”
大殿内静悄悄的，落针可闻。
大长老与三长老仿若无意般对视了一眼，然后三长老开口道：“阁主，老夫以为，青云宗此番所提并宗之事，并非毫无可行之处。青云宗与我云霄阁，并立苍州数百年，彼此井水不犯河水。然而今日天下大势，似有风起云涌之兆。如何在动荡时代生存下去，乃是我等首要考虑之事。青云宗与我云霄阁合二为一，不仅可继续称霸苍州，就算日后面临其他州的宗门势力，也可有一拼之力。”
三长老话音刚落，大长老连连点头，“三长老所言极是，如今诸多宗门要么寻求合并，要么结盟，还有的干脆直接归附大宗门，修真界似有重新洗牌之势。我云霄阁虽然在苍州与青云宗并称两大霸主，然而云霄阁与青云宗相比，青云宗实力强于云霄阁至少两成。我观那余东海并宗之心甚是坚定，如若云霄阁不同意，他必定会强行施为。到时，我云霄阁如何抵挡？”
大长老刚说完，五长老就就开口道：“余东海此人阴险狡诈，此时虽美其名曰并宗后两宗仍保留相应道统，阁主与他并为两大宗主。然而之后，他肯定会慢慢瓦解我云霄阁之势力，在重要职位安插他的亲信，到时，我云霄阁被他从内部一点点蚕食殆尽，云霄阁真的就不复存在，难道我等不愧对云霄阁的开山祖师？”
五长老的声音还在大殿内回荡，三长老就急忙说道：“胡说八道！你又怎知余宗主是何种为人？余宗主光明磊落，一心只想两宗合并后，两宗同心聚力，以获得更快发展，抵御即将到来的外州之敌。五长老不要以小人之心度君子之腹。”
content_en:
The next few days passed uneventfully. Mo Fan still sleeps with Xueer hugging each other every night. But the most intimate gesture is just kissing Xueer's forehead.
It's not that Mo Fan is a gentleman, but he learned from the memory of Young Pavilion Master Mo Fan that there is a saying in the Xuanwu Continent that losing one's virginity too early will have an impact on the progress of future cultivation and the height that can be achieved for both men and women.
Unless you reach the Nascent Soul realm, it doesn't matter whether you are a child or not.
Therefore, no matter how much Mo Fan wanted to move towards the beauty in his arms, he had to hold back.
At night, Xue'er leaned in Mo Fan's arms, her face was red, and she whispered in a low voice, "Xiao Fan, I got married to you because I really like you. What do you think of me?"
Mo Fan hugged Xue'er forcefully and said, "Of course my feelings for you are true. The sun and the moon can tell!"
"Then why don't you..."
Mo Fan was stunned for a moment, and then he understood what Xue'er was talking about. He stroked Xue'er's hair, "I don't want that to affect your practice."
Xueer hugged Mo Fan, "Even if it affects me, I don't regret it. I'm afraid..."
Mo Fan knew that she was worried that she didn't have much time left.
"Don't worry about this. My health is getting better now. Haven't you noticed? I can come and go freely now. It's okay if Xiaoyue is not with me. I will live for a long time and travel with you in the Xuanwu Continent in the future." Mo Fan said firmly.
"Really? You won't leave me?"
"No."
"Then let's pull the hook."
After pulling the hook, Xueer fell into a deep sleep.
Mo Fan quietly got up and went to the courtyard to meditate.
After practicing like this for five or six days, Mo Fan has reached the ninth level of Qi Refining.
It only took a few days for an ordinary person without a trace of spiritual power to reach the ninth level of Qi Refining. This speed of cultivation was shocking in the entire Xuanwu Continent.
However, judging by the age of the young pavilion master, he is already twenty years old. He is still just building a foundation and is still a waste.
Xuanwu Continent respects martial arts and advocates cultivation. Except for people like Young Pavilion Master Mo Fan who are unable to practice, they all started practicing since childhood, either joining a sect, joining a clan force, or entering a cultivation academy run by the imperial court.
It is said that the most dazzling genius in the Xuanwu Continent is a young man from the Tianxuan Sect who entered the realm of pill formation at the age of fifteen years and three months, setting a record for the youngest person to do so.
Compared with these geniuses, Mo Fan feels that his current level is nothing but bullshit.
But, I have a ring in my hand. Its mystery discovered so far may only be a small part. Perhaps, the ring is the biggest help for him to reach the top of Xuanwu Continent.
Moreover, with the current speed of cultivation, it is definitely possible to catch up with those geniuses. Mo Fan is full of confidence!
That night, Mo Fan practiced in the courtyard as usual. After the spiritual energy of heaven and earth was injected into the body and converted into spiritual power, Mo Fan felt a bulging sensation in his Dantian.
A breakthrough is coming! Mo Fan was secretly excited.
Continuous spiritual energy is gathering into Dantian, and the bulging feeling is getting stronger and stronger.
Finally, there was a "click" in the body, breaking through to the foundation building stage!
Mo Fan looked inside his dantian with his spiritual consciousness and found that a small lake had formed in his dantian. The lake is only one foot square, and inside it is the lake water formed by condensing spiritual power. The surface of the lake is covered with a dense fog of spiritual power that has not yet condensed into lake water.
The foundation has been established. According to the standards of Xuanwu Continent, this is the true starting point of cultivation! Only when you reach the foundation building stage can you truly differentiate yourself from ordinary people.
Suppressing his inner excitement, Mo Fan continued to use the Evergreen Secret to absorb the spiritual energy of the world.
A steady stream of spiritual energy enters the body, is transformed into spiritual power, and converges toward the Dantian. Mo Fan's Dantian is also expanding little by little, from one foot at the beginning, to one and a half feet, two feet, two and a half feet, three feet. The dantian lake has stabilized, and Mo Fan's state has also stabilized at the foundation level.
After stabilizing his realm, Mo Fan practiced Yunxiao Sword Technique again. This set of swordsmanship, after some improvements with the ring, has become much more powerful than before. Mo Fan estimated that the current level of Yunxiao Sword Technique should be at the top level of Earth level. Of course, Mo Fan's level still cannot bring out the full power of the sword technique.
Moreover, Mo Fan had a vague feeling that this Yunxiao Sword Technique should be able to continue to advance.
Mo Fan has already taught Mo Weifeng, Li Qiulan and Xue'er the Yunxiao Sword Technique and its sword movement techniques. When Qingyun Sect comes to visit, Yunxiao Sword Technique may give them a surprise.
More than twenty days will pass like this. On this day, in the Yunxiao Pavilion meeting hall, Mo Weifeng was sitting on the throne directly above the hall. There were more than a dozen chairs lined up on both sides, sitting on each of the five elders, the masters of the Chuan Gong Hall, the Martial Arts Hall, the Pill Hall, and the Law Enforcement Hall. Li Qiulan and Mo Fan stood on either side behind Mo Weifeng.
Mo Weifeng spoke slowly: "Everyone, according to the wishes of the Great Elder, we are summoned here today to discuss how to deal with the Qingyun Sect tomorrow. What are your countermeasures?"
It was so quiet in the hall that you could hear a pin drop.
The first elder and the third elder looked at each other as if unintentionally, and then the third elder said: "Pavilion Master, I think that the merger of sects proposed by the Qingyun Sect is not impossible. The Qingyun Sect and my Yunxiao Pavilion have been standing side by side in Cangzhou for hundreds of years, and they have not interfered with each other. However, The general situation in the world today seems to be turbulent. How to survive in the turbulent era is our top priority. If the Qingyun Sect and our Yunxiao Pavilion become one, we can not only continue to dominate Cangzhou, but also be able to compete with the sect forces in other states in the future. "
As soon as the third elder finished speaking, the first elder nodded repeatedly, "What the third elder said is absolutely true. Nowadays, many sects are either seeking to merge or form alliances, and some simply join the big sects directly. The world of cultivation seems to be reshuffling. Although I, Yunxiao Pavilion, am in Cangzhou and Qingyun The Yunxiao Pavilion is the two overlords, but compared to the Qingyun Pavilion, the Qingyun Pavilion is at least 20% stronger than the Yunxiao Pavilion. I think Yu Donghai is very determined to merge the sect. If the Yunxiao Pavilion does not agree, he will definitely do it by force. How can I, the Yunxiao Pavilion, resist?"
As soon as the First Elder finished speaking, the Fifth Elder spoke up and said: "Yu Donghai is a sinister and cunning man. Although the two sects are euphemistically called merged sects, they still retain their corresponding orthodoxy, and the pavilion master and him are merged into two major sect masters. However, in the future, he will definitely slowly Disintegrate the power of our Yunxiao Pavilion and place his cronies in important positions. By then, our Yunxiao Pavilion will be eaten away bit by bit by him, and the Yunxiao Pavilion will really cease to exist. Do I deserve to be the founder of the Yunxiao Pavilion? "
The voice of the fifth elder was still echoing in the hall, and the third elder hurriedly said: "Nonsense! How do you know what kind of person Yu Sect Leader is? Sect Leader Yu is upright and aboveboard. He only wants to unite the two sects to develop faster and resist the upcoming enemies from outside the state. Fifth Elder, don't judge a gentleman with a villain's heart."
title_en: Chapter 7 Foundation Building Chapter 8 Elders Rebellion
